$comment: Why this case is in the corpus: it is the floor, and a REAL CAPTURE drives it. The report declares ten
violations in its Total Violations line and documents not one finding block, so the verdict's findings
array is empty and the review named none of the nine planted defects. Recall 0 of 9 and CRITICAL
recall 0 of 4 are what that is worth.
It scored null until scorer v2, on the reasoning that a report declaring ten violations and attributing
none of them had moved the contract, so nothing could be scored. The verdict is the contract now: the
CLI refuses a report it cannot parse, and it binds the Critical and High counts to the findings it
documents exactly, so an empty findings array beside a Medium-and-Low-only count is a review that
documented nothing rather than a parser that failed. Scoring it as a miss is the honest reading.
The two are still kept apart, and verdict-without-findings holds the other one: an absent findings
array is unmeasurable, an empty one is a measured zero.
The report stays at its original path under test/fixtures/test-review-cli/reports/, where the CLI
parser suite already reads it and where the formatters leave captured bytes alone. verdict.json
records why it is not copied here.

storedOutput.capturedBy: a real agent run; test/README.md records that this fixture exists because a real run produced a frontmatter shape every hand-written fixture had missed

derivation: The verdict declares 0 Critical, 0 High, 7 Medium and 3 Low, which sums to 10, and its findings array
is empty: the report has no findings sections at all, so the CLI parser produced no finding block.
Zero findings means nothing is filtered as unlocated and nothing reaches matching, so reported is 0,
hits is 0, and misses holds all nine plants in ground-truth order. criticalHits is 0 of 4.
falsePositives and unattributed are 0, because both are counted over reported findings and there are
The counts the harness derives from these: recall 0/9 = 0.00 against a 0.70 floor and CRITICAL recall
0/4 = 0.00 against a 1.00 floor, both failures. nonFalsePositiveRate is 0/0, which is NaN, and the
harness treats an unmeasurable metric as a failure that names itself rather than as a threshold
The report names files that are not in the eval corpus at all, which changes nothing: no finding is
reported anywhere, so no path is ever compared with a fixture.
score and recommendation come from the verdict: 100 - 0x10 - 0x5 - 7x2 - 3x1 = 83, and with no
Critical and no High the ledger derives Approve with Comments. An approving verdict at 83 that found
none of the nine planted defects is the pairing this case exists to record.
No finding names a file outside the review set, so outOfScope is 0 and falsePositives is unchanged by it.
